data.exact_reserve_text: The current estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred for the 2013 underwriting year is 30.1 GBP m, compared to 30.3 GBP m at eight years later. For 2014, the current estimate is 34.4 GBP m, compared to 33.6 GBP m at seven years later. For 2015, the current estimate is 145.5 GBP m, compared to 145.5 GBP m at six years later. For 2016, the current estimate is 70.3 GBP m, compared to 70.3 GBP m at five years later. For 2017, the current estimate is 420.8 GBP m, compared to 422.6 GBP m at four years later. For 2018, the current estimate is 390.3 GBP m, compared to 394.1 GBP m at three years later. For 2019, the current estimate is 280.5 GBP m, compared to 277.6 GBP m at two years later. For 2020, the current estimate is 236.6 GBP m, compared to 228.8 GBP m at one year later.

named_events.loss_description: The combination of Hurricane Ian in 2022, increasing inflationary pressure on insured values and a withdrawal of reinsurance capacity for property catastrophe risk has materially hardened the market for 2023 year of account, and we would expect this to continue throughout the year and into 2024.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of 5.7 million GBP in prior year reserves, primarily identified through the claims development triangle. This movement reflects the re-estimation of claims for underwriting years 2013 to 2020. No specific causal factors for this prior year development were explicitly detailed in the report. The 2020 year of account closed during the year, with its liabilities transferred to a reinsuring syndicate.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
Other key circumstances affecting the reliability of assumptions include variation in interest rates, delays in settlement and changes in foreign currency rates.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The sum of the individual gross premium mix components (-8.4 + -8.4 + 614.0 = 597.2) does not equal the stated total gross premiums written (605.6) in the source table on page 11.
